reading: emit-only, same-apparatus delta on host DANIELDILLBERG. The promotion measurement is DDA vs the GAUNTLET-1b COLLAPSE baseline (not frozen): collapse emit p99 5354 µs vs the DDA 4734 µs (1130 permille of the collapse at p99); the cumulative frozen->DDA is 6934 -> 4734 µs (1464 permille), for context only. All three emits reproduced the frozen pixel witness (byte-identical — gate-enforced by gauntlet1-equiv / gauntlet1c-dda, not by this record), and the DDA does the floor's perspective divide per ROW (2590 div/rem ops over 518 rows) where the collapse did per PIXEL (1389296 over 694648 px). The promotion bar is the reader's: promote iff byte-identical AND the DDA emit p99 is strictly below the collapse's (vs_collapse > 1000 permille); identical-but-not-faster than the baseline is a correctness pass and a performance fail. This is an EMIT-level number, NOT the whole render, and NEVER compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute (a different apparatus). Witnesses were checked before any number was taken
